```python
import pandas as pd
fp = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/4d0aa727-86b1-406b-9b33-f870dd14a4a5.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(fp)
# Clean: drop rows missing key fields
key_cols = ['Number','Operating Status','Excursion/Location']
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=key_cols)
# Filter: Sunset Picnic Trip + Operational
mask_trip = df_clean['Excursion/Location'].str.strip() == 'Sunset Picnic Trip'
mask_op = df_clean['Operating Status'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'operational'
sunset_ops = df_clean[mask_trip & mask_op]
# Steam detection via typical steam wheel arrangements keywords
steam_patterns = ['0-4-0','2-6-0','4-4-0','2-8-0','4-6-2','2-6-2','2-8-2','2-10-0','4-6-0','4-8-4']
steam_mask = sunset_ops['Type/Wheel Configuration'].astype(str).str.lower().apply(
    lambda x: any(p in x for p in steam_patterns)
)
num_total = len(sunset_ops)
num_steam = int(steam_mask.sum())
prob = num_steam/num_total if num_total>0 else 0
print({"total_sunset_operational": num_total,
       "steam_in_sunset_operational": num_steam,
       "probability": prob,
       "odds_format": f"1 in {num_total//num_steam}" if num_steam==1 else (f"{num_steam} in {num_total}" if num_steam>1 else "0 in 0")})
```
